items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer asks about Marva Josie, but the interviewee does not respond or provide any personal information about her.

ctx.x: And they say she's the one who started that. If they can make money saying whatever they say, they just say it.

Yeah sure that's the business, isn't it? Well listen, there are some gals that have quite alot on the ball and somehow or another can't make it. What about Marva Josie? I mean it's a shame. The Girl tries hard. She's a pretty girl. She's got a
pretty voice. But somehow or other nothing happens.
